name: How should I prepare before contacting a contractor for an interior renovation estimate?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before contacting a contractor for an interior renovation estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting a quote, define your project goals, preferred aesthetic, and maximum spending limit. Document any functional issues in the current space, such as poor lighting, inadequate storage, or damaged drywall and trim. It helps to gather reference photos of tile patterns, paint colors, and cabinetry styles to communicate your vision clearly. You should also decide early whether the scope involves keeping the existing layout or relocating plumbing fixtures and walls, as altering utility locations significantly impacts both budget and project scheduling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define your design goals, set a clear budget range, identify any structural or utility changes you want, and collect visual examples of preferred finishes and layouts.
